findings.desc: doc-code-drift: plan.md M1 milestone-summary-table rollup status says plain "reviewed-pass" but the plan's own M1 sub-objective table (same file) marks M1.d and M1.f as "reviewed-pass (corrected)" -- an internal status-rollup inconsistency within the plan doc. Compare: M0 rollup correctly carries a bare correction note with all subs plain, and M3 rollup correctly propagates its M3.e sub-objective correction (both consistent patterns), but M1 does not propagate its own M1.d/M1.f corrections to the M1 rollup row. The underlying corrections are real and match the findings doc (M1 correction: milestone_status spawns read-only git subprocesses via currentMilestoneStatusEvidenceBinding, contradicting a literal zero-subprocess reading of runCommands:false; M6 correction: status/closeout output carries no explicit DONE/Authority/production disclaimer string). Fix: change the M1 row in the milestone summary table from "reviewed-pass" to "reviewed-pass (corrected)" for consistency with its own sub-objective rows and with the findings doc M1 Verdict line (executed-pass (clarified)).
